Software Requirements Specification
Automation is required for GDN and GRN
Version 1.0 ● 293106
28 Jan 2026

# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
This document defines the FPPO Goods Movement Automation between the multiple GSTIN of same company, based on the approved process flow.

# Business Requirement
The automation covers the end-to-end flow starting from Sales Order creation at one Unit through dispatch, invoicing, receipt at another Unit, and reverse invoicing back to the first Unit.
The remaining processes not linked to material movement will continue to be handled manually.

# Scope
The Scope of these specs is to facilitate :
• Automation of inter-unit goods movement transactions

# Section 2. Assumptions
• Sales Order : User created Sales Order at Bangalore Unit.
• Sourcing and Material Requisition
• System shall generate material requisition based on Sales Order.
• Approval workflow: PD → FPPO
• FPO : will be created in the Bangalore Division
• FPPO : will be created in the Andhra Pradesh Unit
• Destination/Input site(Andhra Pradesh site) and Available quantity site(Bangalore Site) are related to different Divisions

# Section 3. Functional Requirement Description
Functional Behaviour
Case 1: Single Site Selected
When the user selects a single Site:
• The system shall invoke the backend API to retrieve the corresponding Stock Site.
• The fetched Stock Site shall be automatically populated in the Stock Site dropdown.
• The hyperlink (>>) shall not be displayed.
• The user shall be able to view the populated Stock Site value as per standard dropdown behavior.
Example:

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 1 rows · columns: Site (text), Stock Site (text)]
| Site | Stock Site |
| Delhi Warehouse | Delhi Warehouse |
Case 2: Multiple Sites Selected
When the user selects multiple Sites:
• The Stock Site dropdown shall remain available.
• A hyperlink ">>" shall be displayed adjacent to the Stock Site dropdown.
• The hyperlink shall be enabled and clickable.
• Clicking the hyperlink shall open the Stock Site Allocation popup.
• The user may allocate quantities across one or more Stock Sites.
Example:

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 1 rows · columns: Site (text), Stock Site (text)]
| Site | Stock Site |
| Delhi, Mumbai | [Dropdown ▼] >> |
Case 3: No Site Selected
When no Site is selected:
• The Stock Site dropdown shall remain empty.
• The hyperlink ">>" shall be displayed adjacent to the dropdown.
• Clicking the hyperlink shall open the Stock Site Allocation popup.
Example:

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 1 rows · columns: Site (text), Stock Site (text)]
| Site | Stock Site |
| Blank | [Dropdown ▼] >> |
Stock Site Allocation Popup
Trigger
The popup shall be launched when the user clicks the ">>" hyperlink.
Popup Title
Stock Site Allocation
Popup Fields

[TABLE 4: Table 4 · 2 rows · columns: Field Name (text), Control Type (text), Mandatory (boolean)]
| Field Name | Control Type | Mandatory |
| Stock Site | Dropdown (LOV) | Yes |
| Quantity | Numeric Input | Yes |
Popup Actions
• Add Row (+)
• Delete Row
• Save
• Cancel
Validation Rules
Mandatory Validation
• Stock Site is mandatory.
• Quantity is mandatory.
Quantity Validation
• Only numeric values shall be allowed.
• Negative values shall not be permitted.
• Decimal values shall be supported based on system configuration.
Duplicate Validation
The same Stock Site shall not be selected more than once within the allocation popup.
Validation Message:
"Duplicate Stock Site selection is not allowed."
Save Functionality
Upon clicking Save:
• The system shall validate all entered records.
• The Stock Site allocation details shall be stored against the corresponding transaction record.
• The popup shall be closed.
• The hyperlink (>>) shall continue to be displayed in the grid for records containing multiple-site allocations.
• The saved allocation details shall be available for future viewing and editing.
Tooltip Functionality
For records where the hyperlink (>>) is displayed, hovering over the hyperlink shall display the saved Stock Site allocation summary.
Example Tooltip:
Delhi Warehouse – 50
Mumbai Warehouse – 30
Bangalore Warehouse – 20

# Changes Required :-
We need a setting in order to auto trigger a chain of event which is currently done manually :-
• Setting Name : “Direct issuance to FPPO from different GSTIN”
• Chain-of-events when the above setting is enabled :-
• As soon as the user create a FPPO dispatch instruction(GDI) in the Andhra Pradesh Division against the above FPPO
• System will auto create GDI-Transfer-to -site for the available quantity from source site to the destination site (i.e from the Bangalore site to the Andhra Pradesh site).
• User will manually create a Good dispatch note for the above GDI
• Upon above GDN confirmation, system will auto create a GRN-Transfer-from-site in Andhra Pradesh.
• User will manually confirm the above saved GRN to complete the chain of events
• Upon above confirmation system will auto create Production Process Order Input GDI/GDN from Transfer from Site GRN
• The above transfer to site GDN/GRN will be available for E way bill creation Bangalore to Andhra Pradesh.

# Section 4. Glossary
• No Glossary
